nodes.name: Daily 9AM (Weekdays)
nodes.notes: Weekday-only trigger — cold-calling compliance ke liye weekend exclude by default. Calling-hours window ⚠️ INPUT NEEDED confirm karo (Supprting_files.txt §23: 'Calling hours' production-config item).

parameters.query:
SELECT * FROM clients_master
WHERE COALESCE(call_dnc, false) = false
  AND phone IS NOT NULL AND phone <> ''
  AND score IN ('Hot', 'Warm')
  AND status IN ('Qualified', 'Contacted', 'Replied', 'Nurtured')
  AND (last_call_at IS NULL OR last_call_at < now() - interval '3 days')
  AND COALESCE(call_attempts, 0) < 5
ORDER BY score, updated_at ASC
LIMIT 100;

nodes.name: Postgres - Fetch Callable Leads
nodes.notes: 4.2.1.1: clients_master.call_dnc = internal DNC flag (opt-outs, past 'do not call' requests logged by 4.2.2). '5 attempts' / '3 days' cadence ⚠️ INPUT NEEDED confirm — reasonable default rakha hai.

nodes.name: External DNC Registry Lookup (optional)
nodes.notes: ⚠️ INPUT NEEDED — NDNC_REGISTRY_API_URL: India's National DNC (TRAI/NDNC) registry check needs a subscribed API (e.g. via a telecom/SMS-gateway provider that offers NDNC lookup). Isko abhi DISABLED/bypass rakha hai (node ke aage IF me skip ho jata hai agar env var empty hai) — sirf internal clients_master.call_dnc column hi enforce ho raha hai jab tak ye external check wire na ho. Is node ko delete mat karo, sirf env var set karne se activate ho jayega.

nodes.name: Merge DNC Check Result
nodes.notes: External lookup response-field name 'on_dnc_registry' ⚠️ PLACEHOLDER — actual provider ka response-schema aane par adjust karo.

nodes.name: IF DNC Match (exclude)
nodes.notes: 4.2.1.3: True branch (DNC match) = exclude + mark call_dnc=true in Postgres. False branch = continue to call-list export.

parameters.query: UPDATE clients_master SET call_dnc = true, updated_at = now() WHERE odoo_lead_id = {{$json.odoo_lead_id}};

nodes.name: Execute Workflow - 4.2.2 Dialer Trigger
nodes.notes: 4.2.1 ka output seedha 4.2.2 (Dialer Trigger + Outcome Webhook) ko call-list array ke roop mein pass karta hai — jaisa 2.5→2.6 chaining pattern already established hai. Import ke baad workflowId field ko 4.2.2 ke actual n8n workflow ID se replace karo. S5.8: ye direct data-passing link star topology mein bhi rehta hai (Hub events ke through poora call_list array route karna latency/design ke hisab se sahi nahi — rollout notes ke 'time-sensitive/synchronous data hand-off' exception ke andar aata hai); Report to Hub sirf tracking/observability ke liye parallel add hua hai, ye link replace nahi karta.

nodes.name: Report to Hub
nodes.notes: S5.8 — batch-level report, one per run (call list is built as a single aggregated item, not per-lead), so client_id/odoo_lead_id are null here — payload carries the batch count instead. Runs in parallel with the existing Execute Workflow hand-off to 4.2.2, off the same Build Call-List output. Not yet wired into Hub-Dispatcher (no consumer subscribes to call.outcome yet per S0-EVENT-TYPE-TAXONOMY.md — falls through to flagged_events by design until S5.9's 4.2.2 outcome events give it a real consumer).
